mapper.select: -- 현재 판정의 실제 실행 snapshot을 재사용한다. 관리자 입력으로 profile/추출기를 선택하지 않는다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.source_id=#{sourceId} AND j.set_id=#{setId} AND j.preview_evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} AND j.job_status_code IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED') ORDER BY j.generation DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 1

-- 봉인된 원문의 정확한 파일/선택 extraction ID를 고정한다. 추출 원문과 locator JSON은 반환하지 않는다. SELECT f.id,x.id AS extraction_id,f.document_role_code,f.role_origin_code,f.stable_locator_hash, f.binary_hash,f.download_status_code,f.sort_order,x.extractor_version,x.extractor_config_hash FROM announcement_source_attachment_files f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT original.id,original.extractor_version,original.extractor_config_hash FROM announcement_source_attachment_extractions original WHERE original.file_id=f.id AND original.source_id=f.source_id AND original.set_id=f.set_id ORDER BY original.attempt_no DESC,original.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ON true WHERE f.source_id=#{sourceId} AND f.set_id=#{setId} ORDER BY f.sort_order,f.id LIMIT 11
mapper.insert: -- 새 set에 역할만 달리 복사한다. 원본 파일/실패/품질 이력은 UPDATE하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_files (id,set_id,source_id,stable_locator_hash,safe_locator_json,display_name,detected_type_code, document_role_code,role_origin_code,download_status_code,downloaded_bytes,binary_hash,sort_order,error_code) SELECT #{newFileId},#{newSetId},original.source_id,original.stable_locator_hash,original.safe_locator_json, original.display_name,original.detected_type_code,#{role},#{roleOrigin},original.download_status_code, original.downloaded_bytes,original.binary_hash,original.sort_order,original.error_code FROM announcement_source_attachment_files original JOIN announcement_source_attachment_sets source_set ON source_set.id=original.set_id AND source_set.source_id=original.source_id WHERE original.id=#{originalFileId} AND original.set_id=#{originalSetId} AND original.source_id=#{sourceId} AND source_set.set_status_code='SEALED'

-- 다운로드/추출을 다시 수행한 것처럼 시각을 갱신하지 않는다. 재사용 provenance와 결과 동일성은 DB trigger로 검증한다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_extractions (id,file_id,set_id,source_id,attempt_no,extractor_code,extractor_version,extractor_config_hash, quality_code,extracted_text,text_hash,blocks_json,character_count,page_count,duration_ms,error_code,created_at,reused_from_extraction_id) SELECT #{newExtractionId},#{newFileId},#{newSetId},original.source_id,original.attempt_no,original.extractor_code, original.extractor_version,original.extractor_config_hash,original.quality_code,original.extracted_text, original.text_hash,original.blocks_json,original.character_count,original.page_count,original.duration_ms, original.error_code,original.created_at,original.id FROM announcement_source_attachment_extractions original WHERE original.id=#{originalExtractionId} AND original.file_id=#{originalFileId} AND original.set_id=#{originalSetId} AND original.source_id=#{sourceId}
